scopeClasses.name: Login only

steps.title: Confirm you have a registered business with an admin who can verify it
steps.detail: Advanced Access requires Business Verification and individual verification is no longer allowed. Without a business entity, stop here or stay with login only.
inputs: Legal business name, address, registration or tax documents

steps.title: Sign in to the App Dashboard and create the app, choosing the Instagram or Facebook Login use case and connecting your business portfolio
inputs: A Facebook account with a business portfolio

steps.title: Build and test in Development mode with people who hold roles on the app
steps.detail: Only role holders can grant permissions until the app is Live and the permissions are approved.
inputs: Tester, developer or admin roles for your team

steps.title: Set the redirect URI, privacy policy URL, data deletion callback and the 1024 by 1024 app icon in Settings
inputs: Redirect URI from your auth config
Data deletion callback or instructions URL

steps.title: For login only: switch the app to Live mode. public_profile and email need no review
Make at least one successful API call with every permission you will request
inputs: A test Instagram professional account or Page

steps.title: Record a screen recording per permission showing the grant and the use, and write the use case text and reviewer access instructions
steps.detail: A permission without a recording is not approved.

steps.title: Complete Business Verification as a Business admin: upload documents and confirm by text, call or email
steps.detail: Vendors report reviews of up to 14 business days. Meta publishes no duration.
inputs: Business license, articles of incorporation or tax registration
Phone or email on the business

steps.title: Submit App Review for each permission and plan on the reported wait
steps.detail: Meta states a decision within a week. Vendors report 17 to 20 days in 2026.

steps.title: If your app serves other businesses, complete Tech Provider access verification
inputs: Business portfolio that claims the app

steps.title: Switch to Live mode, watch the Instagram rate limit, and calendar the annual Data Use Checkup
steps.detail: Missing the Data Use Checkup costs API access.

playbooks.symptom: Users outside your team cannot grant the Instagram permissions.
playbooks.cause: The app is in Development mode or the permissions only have Standard Access, which works for role holders alone.
playbooks.fix: Get Advanced Access through App Review and Business Verification, then switch to Live mode.

playbooks.symptom: The App Review submission was rejected with no approval for one permission.
playbooks.cause: A missing screen recording, no successful API call with that permission, or reviewers could not access the app.
playbooks.fix: Add a recording for every permission, make the API calls, and give reviewer credentials with step by step instructions. Resubmit.

playbooks.symptom: Business Verification is stuck or rejected.
playbooks.cause: Documents that do not match the legal name and address, or no Business admin completing the flow.
playbooks.fix: Have a Business admin resubmit matching documents and confirm the code by text, call or email. Vendors report up to 14 business days.

playbooks.symptom: You are a solo developer and the dashboard will not grant Advanced Access.
playbooks.cause: Individual verification is no longer a path; Advanced Access needs a verified business.
playbooks.fix: Register a business entity or stay with login only permissions. There is no third option on this platform.
